Class WaitingListRepository

java.lang.Object
com.andreibel.server.dbController.repository.WaitingListRepository
public class WaitingListRepository extends Object
Repository for Waiting List operations.

Manages waiting list entries with smart priority sorting: - Customers with reservations sorted by reservation time (earliest first) - Walk-in customers sorted by arrival time (FIFO)

Author:
Aviv

      public Waiting addWaiting(Waiting waiting) throws SQLException

    • getCurrentWaitingActive

      public List<Waiting> getCurrentWaitingActive() throws SQLException
      Retrieves active waiting customers sorted by priority:

      Priority 1: Customers with reservations, sorted by reservation time (orderDateTime) - earliest first Priority 2: C ustomers without reservations, sorted by FIFO (waitingDateTime) - arrival first

      Example scenario (current time 14:30): - Customer with reservation 14:45 arrives at 14:30 → placed before reservation 15:00 - Customer with reservation 15:00 → placed after reservation 14:45 - Walk-in customer with no reservation → placed after all reservations, sorted by arrival time

      Returns:
      sorted list of currently waiting customers (isCurrentlyWaiting = 1)
      Throws:
      SQLException - if database operation fails

    • removeNotTodayWaitingList

      public void removeNotTodayWaitingList() throws SQLException
      Removes a customer from the waiting list.

      If the customer has a reservation (orderNumber), the order will be cancelled. If the customer is a walk-in (no orderNumber), they are simply removed from waiting.

      The entry is marked as isCurrentlyWaiting = 0 (soft delete to preserve history).

      Throws:
      SQLException - if database operation fails or customer not found

    • findWaitingDueToClose

      public List<Waiting> findWaitingDueToClose(LocalDateTime now) throws SQLException
      Batch-completes waiting entries that have been seated for 2 hours.

      This method is intended for a scheduler. It marks waiting entries as completed when: they have arrived (waitingArriveDateTime IS NOT NULL), are not yet completed, and their arrival time is earlier than now - 2 hours.

      Parameters:
      now - reference time used to compute the cutoff now.minusHours(2)
      Returns:
      list of waiting entries that were closed (for printing invoices)
      Throws:
      SQLException - if a database access error occurs
